concepts.name: 스크래치 & 컷 아케이드 (Scratch & Cut)
concepts.thesis: The visitor performs the logo: the hero is not a headline but a silver-foil lottery ticket that the thumb slices open, every scratch stroke is TaxCut's green cut line turning 55,000원 into 0원, and the coupon code the ticket spits out is the handoff line into the Kakao chat.

typography.display: Black Han Sans 400 (its only weight) for H1, H2, tile and stage titles, the giant '0원', the stamps and the footer tagline. Fallback stack: 'Black Han Sans','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif with font-weight 900 on the fallback. Never used below 18px.
typography.body: Noto Sans KR 400/500/700 for all body copy, labels, form controls, FAQ, receipt rows. Fallback: -apple-system,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic','Noto Sans KR',sans-serif. 15px/1.6 mobile, 17px desktop.
typography.numeric: Bebas Neue 400 for the HUD digits (30px/36px), prices (64px/88px), stage indices, coupon code and receipt barcode caption; every digit wrapped in an inline-block span with min-width .62em and text-align center so the clock never jitters regardless of font metrics, plus font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums as belt-and-braces. Montserrat 700/800 for the tiny Latin caps eyebrows (TIME LEFT, TICKET, STAGE 01, HELP, PRESS START, SCRATCH TO CUT) and the inline badge, matching the logo SVGs. Fallback: Impact,'Arial Narrow',Arial,sans-serif.
typography.rationale: Black Han Sans is literally the wordmark face, so the headline, the '0원' reveal and the logo speak in one voice and the page looks like the YouTube banner came alive. Bebas Neue is a scoreboard face: condensed, all-caps, loud at 30px in a 56px bar, which is exactly what makes the timer read as a game HUD rather than a countdown widget. Montserrat is already inside the badge SVG, so reusing it for the micro-caps costs nothing and keeps the Latin voice consistent. Noto Sans KR does the trust work: the receipt, FAQ and form are set in it at generous sizes so a 26-year-old with zero tax knowledge reads a calm tax office, not a casino. Load once: fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Black+Han+Sans&family=Noto+Sans+KR:wght@400;500;700&family=Bebas+Neue&family=Montserrat:wght@700;800&display=swap. Korean families arrive in unicode-range slices, so metric-matched fallbacks and no fixed-width headline boxes are mandatory to avoid a reflow jolt.

concepts.first_frame_400px: Viewport 400 x ~650 (Instagram in-app). 0-56px: the HUD, --navy-900 with the faint diagonal stripes. Left: the badge logo at 28px. Next: eyebrow 'TIME LEFT' in green Montserrat 9px caps over '첫 달 기장료 무료까지 남은 시간' in --ink-muted 11px; beside it the digits '29:59' in Bebas Neue 30px --green, colon blinking. Then a chamfered chip with a pulsing green dot and '이벤트 진행 중'. Far right: a 36px --kakao chamfered square with the black speech-bubble icon. Flush along the bar's bottom edge: the health bar, 30 green segments with 2px gaps, every 5th a tick taller, all full. 56-80px: the attract ticker, 11px --ink-muted caps drifting left: '세금을 자르는 가장 빠른 방법 · 첫 달 기장료 0원 · 세무회계 민 · 유튜브 @taxcut_min'. 96-136px: the wordmark inline SVG at 112x40 sitting on the 16px left gutter (green spaced 'TAXCUT', white '택스컷' with the green cut through it) and '세무회계 민' in 11px --ink-muted to its right. 144-228px: the H1, Black Han Sans 36px/1.15, white, left-aligned, two lines: '기장료 55,000원,' then '긁어서 0원으로.' A 6px green line at -12 degrees is mid-way through drawing itself across '55,000원'; '0원' is --green. 238-308px: the subhead, Noto Sans KR 15px/1.55 --ink-soft, three lines: '이 페이지에서 30분 안에 상담 및 계약 완료 시 첫 달 기장료 무료. 세무 지식 0이어도 괜찮아요, 사장님.' 326-556px: the ticket, 368x230, rotated -2.5 degrees, the only rounded object (14px), 2px green border, sitting in a 320px soft green radial glow. Its face is silver holographic foil (--foil-hi to --foil-lo at 135 degrees) with faint embossed diagonal stripes; a 40px perforated stub runs down its left edge with a dotted line and rotated micro-caps 'TAXCUT · 1ST MONTH FREE'. Printed in navy on the foil: 'SCRATCH TO CUT' micro-caps at top, '여기를 손가락으로 긁으세요' in Black Han Sans 24px at center, '쓱쓱 긁으면 첫 달 기장료가 잘려요' 12px beneath. Bottom-right of the foil: a 36px green coin (navy TAX/CUT micro-text, green cut line) caught mid-way through its diagonal hint stroke. Behind the ticket, 6-8 green coins and 2 pale paper scraps drift upward slowly. 564-582px: two small lines under the ticket, left '55% 이상 긁으면 자동으로 열려요' in --ink-muted 12px, right '긁기 귀찮으면 바로 카톡 상담 →' in white 13px underlined. Pinned to the bottom: the 60px bar (plus safe-area) on --navy-700 with '카톡 상담' in --kakao with the bubble icon (58% width) and '예약하기' in --navy-800 with a 2px green border (42%). Nothing on screen is centered except the ticket; nothing is waiting at opacity 0. At 360px width the ticket is 328x205 and the H1 drops to 34px.
concepts.scratch_card: Two-layer ticket, 8:5 aspect (368x230 at 400px, 520x325 on desktop), radius 14px (the one rounded object on the page), 2px --green border, rotated -2.5 degrees, radial --green-glow behind it, CSS 3D tilt per three_d, desktop cursor over the foil replaced by a data-URI SVG coin. LAYER 1 (DOM, underneath, the prize face): --navy-700 with the stripe texture; a 40px perforated stub on the left (2px dotted --navy-600 line, 'TAXCUT · 1ST MONTH FREE' Montserrat 8px caps rotated -90 degrees); eyebrow '첫 달 기장료' white 14px top-left; center '55,000원' in Bebas 34px white at 45% with an SVG green line (6px, -12 degrees) that draws through it on reveal, then '0원' in Black Han Sans 76px --green; bottom-left a dashed green code slot (Bebas 26px, empty until reveal, with a '복사' button); top-right the stamp anchor. LAYER 2 (canvas, on top, touch-action: none): the foil, painted once at DPR capped to 2: linear gradient 135 degrees --foil-hi to --foil-mid to --foil-lo, the brand's diagonal stripes at 8% (14px period, -30 degrees) as if embossed, ~300 pseudo-random 1px noise dots at 6%, a soft inner vignette. Printed in --navy-800: 'SCRATCH TO CUT' Montserrat 700 10px letter-spacing .24em (top center), '여기를 손가락으로 긁으세요' Black Han Sans 24px (center), '쓱쓱 긁으면 첫 달 기장료가 잘려요' Noto 12px at 70% (below), and a 36px inline-SVG coin (green disc, navy 'TAX/CUT' micro-text, green cut line) parked bottom-right that plays the hint stroke. MECHANIC: Pointer Events with setPointerCapture; pointerdown records a point and calls navigator.vibrate?.(8) (Android only); pointermove draws a round-capped, round-joined line (lineWidth 44 CSS px) with globalCompositeOperation 'destination-out' from the previous point; touchmove inside the card is preventDefault-ed (non-passive) so the WebView never scrolls or pulls-to-refresh; tilt freezes while a pointer is down; foil-shaving particles (3x3px --foil-mid divs, fall 220ms, max 24 alive) spawn at the pointer every 80ms; single taps do nothing (at least 3 move samples required). Progress is sampled every 120ms from the alpha channel of a 1/4-scale offscreen copy: ratio = transparent pixels / total. REVEAL at 55% (a wink at 55,000): (1) 450ms diagonal wipe of the remaining foil from lower-left to upper-right, the logo's cut angle, via an animated clip-path polygon on the canvas, then the canvas is removed from the DOM; (2) card pop: scale 1 to 1.04 to 1 with rotateX 0 to -6 to 0 degrees, 500ms cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3), a --green flash overlay 40% to 0 in 300ms, the glow doubles; (3) the green line draws through '55,000원' (300ms), then '0원' scales in from .6 with overshoot; (4) confetti on a fixed full-screen canvas (pointer-events: none, removed after 1.6s): 90 rectangles and dots in --green, --white, --kakao and --foil-mid with gravity and spin, DPR capped 1.5; (5) the stamp slams in at the top-right, rotated -8 degrees, scale 2 to 1 in 250ms: 'COUPON GET' Montserrat 800 caps over '쿠폰 획득!' Black Han Sans 18px, green 3px border, navy-on-green fill; (6) the code slot types in 'TC-' plus 4 digits, generated once per session (sessionStorage.taxcut_coupon in try/catch), mirrored to the HUD coupon chip and the form's hidden field, with a '복사' button (clipboard API, textarea-select fallback) that flips to '복사됨' for 1.5s; (7) the Three coins spray upward; (8) beneath the ticket the CTA row rises (max-height 0 to 160px, 300ms): --kakao '카톡으로 바로 상담하기' full width, then navy/green-bordered '전화 상담 예약하기' anchoring to #reserve; the anti-bounce line becomes '쿠폰코드를 상담 때 말씀해 주세요'. SESSION MEMORY: if taxcut_coupon already exists on load, the ticket renders pre-revealed (no foil, stamp and code in place) so a refresh never asks anyone to scratch twice. EXPIRED TIMER: the foil still scratches (the game stays fun), but the reveal shows the stamp '이벤트 종료', the code slot reads '상담은 계속 가능해요' and no code is issued, so the page never implies a discount it cannot give. ACCESSIBILITY: the card wrapper is tabindex=0 role=button aria-label='스크래치 카드, Enter를 누르면 열려요'; Enter or Space reveals directly; the prize face text is real DOM so screen readers get '첫 달 기장료 0원' after reveal. REDUCED MOTION: no tilt, no shavings, no confetti, no pop; the foil fades out in 200ms and the stamp appears without motion.
concepts.three_d: Two layers, both safe to lose. (1) CSS 3D, the ticket: wrapper perspective 900px; card transform-style preserve-3d, will-change transform; rotateX/rotateY clamped to +-8 degrees from pointer position relative to the card center, lerped 0.12 per rAF frame; on touch devices deviceorientation adds gamma to rotateY and (beta - 45) to rotateX, clamped +-12 degrees, low-pass filtered at 0.15; on iOS the permission is requested lazily on the first touch only if DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission exists, and silently skipped if denied. Layer depths: prize face translateZ(0), foil canvas translateZ(6px), stamp translateZ(24px), coin hint translateZ(30px). A sheen div (linear-gradient 115 degrees, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.22) 50%, transparent 70%, background-size 250%, pointer-events none) moves its background-position with the tilt so the foil reads as holographic without mix-blend-mode. Tilt freezes while scratching and resumes on pointerup. (2) Three.js r128 from cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js, injected after the window load event via requestIdleCallback (setTimeout 1500 fallback), hero-only background: one InstancedMesh of 24 coins (CylinderGeometry r 0.5, h 0.08, 24 radial segments, MeshLambertMaterial color #3DDC84, emissive #0F5A35) and one InstancedMesh of 8 paper scraps (PlaneGeometry 0.9x0.4, MeshLambertMaterial #C9D3E0, transparent, opacity 0.35, DoubleSide); AmbientLight(0x8FA0B8, 0.7) plus one DirectionalLight(0xFFFFFF, 0.8); PerspectiveCamera fov 55 at z 9 with +-0.4 unit parallax from pointer or tilt, lerped. Per instance: random spin axis at 0.4-1.0 rad/s, upward drift 0.15-0.3 units/s with a sine sway, wrap at the top; on reveal every velocity is multiplied by 4 upward for 1.2s then eases back (the jackpot spray). Renderer: alpha true, antialias false, powerPreference 'low-power', setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5)), no shadows, no post-processing, canvas absolute inset 0 inside the hero at z-index 0 with pointer-events none, resized on a debounced resize. The loop runs only while the hero is at least 20% in the viewport (IntersectionObserver) and document.visibilityState is 'visible'; frames are capped to 30fps when navigator.hardwareConcurrency <= 4 or deviceMemory <= 3. Three is not even loaded when prefers-reduced-motion is set, deviceMemory < 2, connection.saveData is true, or a WebGL context cannot be created (wrapped in try/catch), and the script tag's onerror also triggers the fallback. Fallback: 10 inline-SVG coins (same green disc with cut line, 28-44px) absolutely positioned in the hero with a 14-22s translateY/rotate float keyframe, animation-play-state paused under reduced-motion. Budget: 2 draw calls plus 2 lights, under 4ms per frame on an Adreno 610-class phone; the foil canvas samples a 1/4-scale copy every 120ms; total inline JS under 60KB; the page is complete and looks finished before Three arrives.
concepts.timer_bar: position: sticky; top: 0 (sticky, not fixed, to dodge in-app URL-bar resize glitches), z-index 50, height 56px plus env(safe-area-inset-top), --navy-900 with the 5% diagonal stripe texture, 1px --navy-600 bottom border. Grid '28px 1fr auto 36px', gap 10px, 16px gutters (contents inside a 1120px container on desktop). (a) badge logo inline SVG 28px. (b) label stack: eyebrow 'TIME LEFT' Montserrat 700 9px letter-spacing .2em --green, beneath it '첫 달 기장료 무료까지 남은 시간' Noto 11px --ink-muted; to the right of the stack the digits '29:59' in Bebas Neue 30px --green, each digit an inline-block span of min-width .62em (true tabular), the colon blinking opacity 1 to .35 every 500ms. (c) status chip: chamfered, 11px, a green dot pulsing on a 2s cycle plus '이벤트 진행 중'; after the scratch reveal this chip is replaced by the coupon chip 'TC-4821' (Bebas 14px, dashed --green border, tap copies and flashes '복사됨'), so the code is on screen wherever the visitor scrolls. (d) Kakao mini-button: 36px --kakao chamfered square with the inline speech-bubble SVG in --kakao-ink, aria-label '카카오톡 상담', opens https://pf.kakao.com/_Mxojqs/chat in a new tab with rel=noopener. Flush along the bar's bottom edge: the health bar, 30 segments (one per minute), 6px tall with 2px gaps, filled --green, empty segments outlined 1px --navy-600, every 5th segment 8px tall as a tick; segments drain right to left and the current minute's segment shrinks its width each second with transition: width .9s linear so the bar moves continuously like a draining life bar. States: above 5:00 green; at or under 5:00 the remaining segments and the digits switch to --coral and pulse opacity 1 to .6 on a 0.8s cycle, the Korean label becomes '서두르세요, 5분 남았어요'; at 0:00 all segments are empty outlines, the digits read '00:00' in --ink-muted, the label becomes '이벤트 시간이 종료되었어요. 그래도 상담은 가능해요', the chip reads '이벤트 종료' in --ink-muted, the Kakao button and every CTA stay fully live. Persistence: an inline script placed immediately after the HUD markup reads localStorage.taxcut_event_start in try/catch, writes Date.now() if absent, computes remaining = TAXCUT_CONFIG.EVENT_MINUTES*60 - elapsed and paints the digits and segments synchronously so the first frame never flashes '30:00'; if storage throws, an in-memory start is used. The tick is a 1000ms setInterval corrected against Date.now() (no drift), paused while the tab is hidden and re-synced on visibilitychange. Remaining seconds feed the form's hidden event_seconds_left field at submit time. Accessibility: the visual digits are aria-hidden; a visually-hidden aria-live='polite' node updates only when the minute changes ('남은 시간 29분') and once each at the 5-minute and expiry transitions; the health bar is role=progressbar with aria-valuenow in minutes. Reduced motion: no blink, no pulse, segments step instead of sliding.
sections: 00 GLOBAL FRAME. Single dark theme, body background --navy-800 with a fixed 5% diagonal stripe texture (repeating-linear-gradient at -30 degrees, 14px period) echoing the YouTube banner. Container max-width 1120px; gutters 16px under 600px, 24px under 1000px, 40px above; section padding 56px mobile / 96px desktop; html and body overflow-x: clip. Corner language: nothing is rounded except the scratch ticket; tiles, buttons, chips and panels get a 10px chamfer on the top-left and bottom-right corners via clip-path: polygon(10px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 10px), so every chamfer diagonal runs lower-left to upper-right like the logo's cut. Section headers are left-aligned: Montserrat 10px --green eyebrow (TICKET / WHY TAXCUT / STAGE / HELP / PRESS START) above a Black Han Sans 28px (40px desktop) title, under which a 40x3px --green line tilted -12 degrees is the section marker (no emoji, no centered dividers). Type scale mobile/desktop: H1 36/56, H2 28/40, H3 20/22, body 15/17 at 1.6, caption 12/13, HUD digits 30/36, prices 64/88. Color roles are strict: green for cut lines, HUD, accents, links; yellow only for Kakao; coral only for the timer under 5 minutes and validation; silver only for the foil; paper only for the receipt and the form. All buttons are real <button> or <a>, 56px tall, chamfered, Noto 17px 700, pressed state translateY(1px) and 8% darker; focus ring 3px --green offset 2px (3px --navy-800 on yellow).

01 HUD TIMER BAR. Fully specified in timer_bar. Design role: it is the cabinet's frame; it is the one element always on screen and it carries three things at all times: the true remaining time, the coupon chip once earned, and a Kakao exit. It never scrolls away on any breakpoint.

02 ATTRACT TICKER (optional, the first thing to cut if the first frame gets tight). A 24px strip on --navy-900 under the HUD, Noto/Montserrat 11px --ink-muted letter-spacing .08em, green middle dots between phrases: '세금을 자르는 가장 빠른 방법 · 첫 달 기장료 0원 · 세무회계 민 · 유튜브 @taxcut_min ·' duplicated once for a seamless translateX loop over 60s; aria-hidden (the tagline also lives in the footer); static text under reduced-motion and when the tab is hidden.

03 HERO. Mobile: one column. Text block left-aligned on the gutter: wordmark inline SVG 112x40 with '세무회계 민' 11px --ink-muted beside it; H1 '기장료 55,000원,' / '긁어서 0원으로.' where '55,000원' is wrapped in a span holding an absolutely positioned SVG line (6px --green, -12 degrees, stroke-dashoffset drawn at t+150ms) and '0원' is --green; subhead in --ink-soft containing the verbatim sentence '이 페이지에서 30분 안에 상담 및 계약 완료 시 첫 달 기장료 무료.' followed by '세무 지식 0이어도 괜찮아요, 사장님.' Then the ticket (see scratch_card) centered with its -2.5 degree rotation inside a 320px radial --green-glow. Then a two-cell line: left '55% 이상 긁으면 자동으로 열려요' 12px --ink-muted, right the anti-bounce link '긁기 귀찮으면 바로 카톡 상담 →' 13px white underlined (Kakao URL, new tab, rel=noopener); this link exists before any scratching so nobody is trapped. After the reveal a CTA row rises under the ticket (max-height animation so nothing above shifts): full-width --kakao '카톡으로 바로 상담하기' with the bubble icon, then '전화 상담 예약하기' in --navy-700 with a 2px --green border anchoring to #reserve; the anti-bounce line becomes '쿠폰코드를 상담 때 말씀해 주세요'. Desktop 900px and up: two columns 5/7, text left with H1 at 56px, ticket right at 520x325 rotated -3 degrees with the CTA row beneath it. The Three.js coin scene (or the CSS coin fallback) fills only the hero box at z-index 0 behind everything. The hero's bottom edge is a hard diagonal chamfer into the next section, not a gradient fade.

04 PRICING TICKET (paper). Eyebrow 'TICKET', title '요금, 솔직하게.' on navy, then a --paper panel, max-width 640px, sitting on the left of the container (not centered on desktop), with sawtooth top and bottom edges (clip-path polygon, 8px teeth) like a receipt torn out of the machine; all text navy. Receipt rows in Noto 15px with dotted leaders: row 1 the verbatim line '1개월 기장료 55,000원 (부가세 포함)' in 700; row 2 '첫 달 (이벤트 적용 시) …… 0원'; row 3 '이벤트 조건 …… 이 페이지에서 30분 안에 상담 및 계약 완료 시 첫 달 기장료 무료'. Below the rows the big number: '55,000원' in Bebas 64px (88px desktop) --navy-800 with a 7px --green line that draws through it once when the panel is 50% in view (IntersectionObserver), then '첫 달 0원' in Black Han Sans 56px set as navy text on a --green highlighter block (green text on paper fails contrast, navy on green is 10:1). Footnotes in 13px --paper-muted: '※ 매출액에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다.' and '※ 2개월째부터는 기장료가 정상 청구돼요.' The receipt's foot is an inline-SVG barcode (40 bars of pseudo-random widths in --navy-500) captioned in Bebas 18px with '쿠폰 TC-4821' once revealed, or before that a link '쿠폰은 위의 복권을 긁으면 나와요 ↑' that smooth-scrolls back to the ticket, so even the price section routes to the card.

05 WHY TAXCUT. Eyebrow 'WHY TAXCUT', title '왜 택스컷이냐면요'. Four chamfered tiles on --navy-700 with 1px --navy-600 borders; the chamfered top-left corner is filled --green (the cut corner); a Bebas 14px --green index '01' to '04' at top-right; a 28px inline-SVG icon in 2px --green stroke (speech bubble / person with badge / sprout / play triangle); Black Han Sans 20px title; Noto 14px --ink-soft body; everything left-aligned. Layout: under 480px stacked horizontal tiles with the icon left and text right; 480px and up a 2x2 grid; 1000px and up four across. Copy: '카톡으로 편하게' with '영수증 사진 찍어서 카톡으로 보내면 끝. 전화 통화가 어색해도 괜찮아요.' / '세무사가 직접 상담' with '상담원이 아니라 세무사가 사장님 상황을 직접 듣고 답해요.' / '첫 창업 사장님 맞춤' with '스마트스토어, 카페, 프리랜서… 처음 하는 사장님 눈높이로 설명해요.' / '유튜브 택스컷 채널' with '세금 정보는 @taxcut_min 에서 계속 받아보세요.' (the tile links to the channel in a new tab). No invented numbers anywhere in this section.

06 STAGES. Eyebrow 'STAGE', title '진행은 딱 3단계예요'. Three stages joined by a --green connector line that draws on scroll-into-view: on mobile it runs vertically down the left through 44px chamfered --navy-700 squares holding Bebas 22px '01', '02', '03'; from 800px it runs horizontally across three equal columns. Each stage: Montserrat 10px eyebrow 'STAGE 01', Black Han Sans 20px title, Noto 14px --ink-soft body. Stage 1 '카톡 또는 전화 상담' with '오늘 바로, 10분이면 충분해요.'; Stage 2 '온라인으로 계약' with '방문 없이 온라인으로 간단히 진행해요.'; Stage 3 '기장 시작 & 첫 달 0원' with '이벤트 조건 충족 시 첫 달 기장료가 잘려요.' and a rotated green 'CLEAR' stamp in the same style as the ticket's stamp.

07 FAQ (HELP). Eyebrow 'HELP', title '자주 묻는 질문'. concepts.motion: Page load (every piece of text is visible at t=0; only transforms and SVG strokes animate, never opacity on text): t=0 the HUD already shows the true remaining time and segment count, computed synchronously before first paint; t+150ms the green line draws through '55,000원' in the H1 (stroke-dashoffset, 500ms ease-out); t+400ms the ticket settles from rotateX(10deg) translateY(12px) into place over 600ms with a spring curve (it is visible the whole time, just tilted); t+900ms the green coin drags a hint stroke diagonally across the foil from lower-left to upper-right over 1.2s, repeats once at t+2.5s, then parks bottom-right; if the ticket is untouched for 12s the hint plays once more, then never again. Continuous loops, all paused on visibilitychange and when the hero leaves the viewport: colon blink (500ms), status-dot pulse (2s), ticker (60s), Three coins drifting, the foil sheen tracking the tilt. Micro-interactions: scratch (tilt freezes, 8ms vibrate on Android, foil shavings under the thumb); the reveal sequence in scratch_card (wipe, pop, flash, strike, 0원 overshoot, confetti, stamp slam, code type-in, coin spray, CTA rise); coupon copy flips to '복사됨' for 1.5s with a green fill; every button presses translateY(1px) and darkens 8%; the receipt's price strike and the stage connector draw once when 50% in view; the HUD switches to coral and pulses under 5:00; form errors show a coral border and message without shaking; submit shows '전송 중…' with a spinner, then the '예약 완료!' stamp slams in (scale 1.4 to 1, 200ms) with a 30-particle burst. What stays still: all body copy, the receipt rows, the four tiles, the stage text, the FAQ, the form, the footer; nothing in those sections loops. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns every line into a pre-drawn static line, freezes the ticker, disables tilt, blink, pulse, confetti and the coin spray, skips loading Three entirely and pauses the CSS coins; the reveal becomes a 200ms fade of the foil.

concepts.aesthetic_risk: The hero is an object, not a headline. A silver holographic foil ticket, the only thing on the page that is neither navy nor green and the only rounded shape, sits larger than the H1, tilts with the phone, sheds foil shavings under the thumb, and withholds the coupon code until it is scratched. It bets that on a phone arriving from an Instagram or 당근 ad, touch beats reading: the ticket gives the visitor something to do in the first two seconds (past the bounce window), the 55% auto-open guarantees a jackpot after about three seconds of effort, and the code it issues is the literal handoff line into Kakao ('쿠폰코드를 상담 때 말씀해 주세요'), so the game ends in the conversation the page exists for. The rails that keep it from looking cheap: silver, yellow and coral each appear in exactly one role, every other surface is sharp-cornered navy with the brand's stripes, and the receipt and form sections are deliberately calm paper.
risks: In-app WebViews (Instagram, 당근) fight the scratch gesture: without touch-action: none plus a non-passive touchmove preventDefault inside the card, a stroke becomes a page scroll or a pull-to-refresh; keep the ticket inside the 16px gutters so an edge swipe never starts on it. iOS needs a lazy deviceorientation permission request and has no navigator.vibrate; both must degrade silently to pointer-only tilt.

Three.js r128 is roughly 600KB and irrelevant to conversion; it must load only after the load event, be skipped on saveData or low-memory devices, and the CSS coin fallback must look identical so nobody can tell which version they got. The page has to look finished before the script arrives.

Foil canvas cost on DPR 3 phones: cap the foil canvas at DPR 2, sample progress from a 1/4-scale copy at most every 120ms, and never call getImageData on the full canvas, or scratching stutters on mid-range Android.

Three accents (Kakao yellow, coral, silver) on top of green can tip into carnival; the role rules (yellow only on Kakao buttons, coral only under 5 minutes and on validation, silver only on the foil) are load-bearing and must not be relaxed for decoration.
Green text on the paper sections fails 4.5:1 (about 2.3:1); on paper green is only ever a line or a fill block with navy text on it.

Black Han Sans and Noto Sans KR arrive in unicode-range slices; use display=swap, metric-matched fallbacks (Apple SD Gothic Neo / Malgun Gothic at 900) and no fixed-width headline boxes, or the H1 reflows visibly a second after paint.

The coupon code is client-generated and unverifiable; the office must treat it as a conversation key, not proof of eligibility (the 30-minute condition is the timer plus the office's own records). A new tab produces a new code, which is acceptable, but the HUD chip, the receipt barcode caption and the hidden form field must always show the same value.
If localStorage is blocked (private mode in some in-app browsers) the timer restarts on reload; this is honest enough to ship but should be stated in the file header comment.
The attract ticker is the element most likely to read cheap; it is deliberately tiny, muted and slow, and it is the first thing to remove if the client hesitates or the first frame gets tight.
Legal copy is placeholder in two places: the privacy note's retention period and the FAQ answer on contract length are written in a '상담 시 안내' tone and must be confirmed by 세무회계 민 before launch.

The post-reveal CTA row and the success stamp both change layout; both must animate max-height beneath their trigger so nothing above the finger moves, and the confetti canvas must be pointer-events: none and removed after 1.6s so it never blocks a tap on the Kakao button.
On Android the keyboard shrinks the visual viewport and the sticky bottom bar can cover the focused input; hide the bar while any form control has focus and show it again on blur.

concepts.scratch_card: MECHANIC: 3-layer card inside a perspective wrapper. Layer 0 base plate (--navy-800 with the 45° stripe texture, 14px radius). Layer 1 coupon face: --paper 'receipt' — top-left eyebrow 'TAXCUT COUPON' Montserrat 700 10px --green-ink tracking 0.3em, top-right the 24px badge SVG; '첫 달 기장료' Black Han Sans 22px --navy-900; '0원' Montserrat 900 56px --navy-900 with a 5px --green-ink UNDERLINE (0 is never struck); a dashed perforation box holding '코드 TC-4821' Montserrat 800 18px tabular; bottom line '쿠폰코드를 상담 때 말씀해 주세요' Noto 12px --paper-mute. Code = 'TC-' + 4 digits generated once per session (crypto.getRandomValues, fallback Math.random) and stored under 'taxcut_coupon' in localStorage (try/catch; in-memory fallback), reused on refresh. Layer 2 foil: a canvas sized CSS×min(devicePixelRatio,1.5), painted with a 135° gradient --foil-hi→--foil-mid→--foil-lo, a fine 1px diagonal grain, a tiled 'TAXCUT' security print at 6% navy, and the prompt text ('여기를 긁어보세요' 24px Black Han Sans navy, a 48px --green-ink line at −12°, caption 12px). Pointer Events with `touch-action: none` on the canvas; pointerdown freezes the 3D tilt (so the brush maps to the canvas exactly), captures the pointer, and draws round-cap lines between samples with globalCompositeOperation 'destination-out', radius 22px touch / 16px mouse, batched per requestAnimationFrame. On pointerup, sample alpha every 12th pixel (~1,200 samples); at ≥45% cleared the reveal fires. Keyboard/canvas-unsupported fallback: a visually-hidden-until-focused button '탭해서 쿠폰 열기' performs the same reveal. REVEAL MOMENT (≈900ms total): remaining foil fades out 350ms; a 4px --green line draws corner-to-corner (lower-left → upper-right) on a floating SVG layer above the card in 350ms; the 0원 underline draws; 8 four-point SVG sparkles scale in around the code; a full-hero-width canvas throws 60 confetti rectangles in --green, #9BF0C3, --paper and white for 1.2s with simple gravity, then the canvas is removed. A 40ms haptic (navigator.vibrate, guarded) on Android. Under prefers-reduced-motion: foil disappears instantly, line pre-drawn, no confetti, sparkles static. AFTER: the CTA slot under the card expands (300ms max-height, content already opaque): Kakao button 56px full-width (#FEE500/#191919, inline SVG speech bubble, '카톡으로 상담 시작'), then '전화 예약하기 (30초)' white outline with a 3px --green underline that sweeps left→right on press and scrolls to #reserve; under both, 12px --ink-mute '쿠폰코드 TC-4821을 상담 때 말씀해 주세요'. The coupon code is also copied into the form's hidden field and shown as a small pill beside the form heading. State 'revealed' persists in localStorage so a refresh shows the opened coupon.
concepts.three_d: CSS 3D only, no Three.js: the audience is on mid-range Android in-app WebViews where WebGL context creation is flaky and r128 adds ~600KB; the angle calls for one precise 3D object, and one floating card does not need a GPU scene. OBJECTS: the scratch card group under `perspective: 900px` (perspective-origin 50% 40%), `transform-style: preserve-3d`, `will-change: transform` — (a) `.card-shadow` translateZ(−30px): a --navy-950 rectangle blurred 18px, rasterized once and moved with the group; (b) `.card-base` translateZ(0): stripes + paper coupon face; (c) `.card-foil` canvas translateZ(14px) so the foil visibly floats above the coupon and parallaxes against it when tilted; (d) `.card-cut` SVG line translateZ(28px), hidden until reveal; (e) `.card-glare` a soft white linear-gradient at 12% whose background-position moves opposite to the tilt via the same CSS variables. CAMERA/INPUT: tilt = rotateX(clamp(−8°..8°)) rotateY(clamp(−10°..10°)) driven by CSS vars --tx/--ty; on mouse, from pointer position over the card (lerp 0.12 per frame, spring back on leave); on Android phones, from `deviceorientation` beta/gamma (deadzone 2°, clamp ±20° → ±10°, smoothed); on iOS (DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission exists) do NOT prompt — use touch position while touching instead. Tilt freezes on pointerdown over the foil and resumes on pointerup. Idle pose when untouched: a 6s ease-in-out loop translateY ±4px + rotateY 0→3°→0 (transform only). Desktop hero: the edge-to-edge cut line runs BEHIND the card (z-index under the perspective wrapper) so the card reads as floating above the cut. FALLBACK: `@supports not (transform-style: preserve-3d)` → flat card, no tilt; canvas unavailable → tap-to-open button; `prefers-reduced-motion` → no idle float, no tilt, instant reveal; `visibilitychange` hidden → cancel the rAF loop. PERF BUDGET: only transform/opacity animate; no box-shadow animation, no backdrop-filter, no filters on moving layers except the pre-rasterized shadow; canvas DPR ≤1.5; one rAF loop for tilt + scratch batching; confetti canvas exists ≤1.5s; total JS < 12KB; target 60fps on a Galaxy A-class WebView, zero WebGL.

concepts.motion: PAGE LOAD (all text painted at full opacity on first frame; no opacity:0 waiting): 0ms everything visible, hero line at dashoffset 100%; 150→800ms the edge-to-edge hero cut line draws left→right (cubic-bezier .2,.8,.2,1); ~800ms '55,000원' dims to opacity .55 and '0원' pops scale .96→1 over 200ms (transform only); 1000ms the scratch card begins its 6s idle float (translateY ±4px, rotateY 0→3°→0) and the timer's progress line starts its per-second 1s-linear scaleX transitions. Nothing else moves on load. SCROLL-TRIGGERED (IntersectionObserver, threshold .5, once each): 가격 strike draws 500ms then the 0원 underline 300ms; the 진행 절차 connector line draws 600ms; section eyebrow rules draw 300ms. No parallax, no scroll-jacking, no background particles. MICRO: every text link and the reserve button have a 2–3px green underline that sweeps left→right 200ms on hover/press; Kakao button scales .98 on :active with a 1px darker edge; form inputs animate only the focus ring; FAQ cut-mark indicator rotates 150ms, panels open without height animation; timer digits flip value only (no tween); under 5:00 the digits pulse opacity at 1Hz. SCRATCH: tilt follows pointer/orientation via lerp .12 per rAF; tilt freezes during scratching; reveal sequence per scratch_card (~900ms incl. 1.2s confetti tail). REDUCED MOTION: all lines pre-drawn, no float/tilt/pulse/confetti/underline sweep; scratch still functions, reveal is instant. STAYS STILL: all body copy, the timer bar itself, the form, the footer, section backgrounds; the only 3D object is the card and the only animated ornament is the line.

concepts.aesthetic_risk: The hero cut line overshoots: it is drawn edge-to-edge across the whole viewport at the wordmark's angle, strikes only the price and keeps going into empty space — and it is the ONLY animated ornament on load (no gradient wash, no particles, no Three.js scene, a left-aligned ragged headline). By AI-landing standards the hero looks 'unfinished'; that is the point. It serves conversion because the entire offer (55,000 → 0) is understood pre-attentively in under a second before a 당근/인스타 visitor decides to bounce, the eye rides the line straight to the one interactive object (the card) and from there to the CTAs, and the restraint keeps the page light enough to hold 60fps and load fast inside an in-app WebView — the two things that actually decide whether a 30-minute window turns into a Kakao chat.
risks: Black Han Sans arrives as multiple Korean unicode-range slices; expect a brief FOUT in in-app WebViews. Use display=swap, fixed line-heights and a weight-matched fallback (Do Hyeon → Apple SD Gothic Neo/Malgun Gothic) so the headline does not reflow when the font lands.

The stack-order trick (Montserrat first, Black Han Sans second) requires `font-synthesis: none` on headline elements, otherwise browsers fake-bold Black Han Sans (400) when Montserrat 900 is requested, smearing the Hangul.

Scratching inside a 3D-transformed element: pointer→canvas mapping must be taken from getBoundingClientRect while tilt is frozen (pointerdown), and the canvas needs `touch-action: none` plus `overscroll-behavior: none` on body so Instagram/당근 WebViews do not pull-to-refresh or scroll mid-scratch.

Do not call DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission on iOS (it would pop a permission dialog and kill trust); detect its presence and fall back to touch-position tilt. Android may fire deviceorientation at 60Hz — throttle via the single rAF loop.

Green as text fails contrast on paper (#3DDC84 ≈1.65:1, #1FB86A ≈2.4:1); on light sections green is only ever the line (--green-ink #0E8F4F, ≈3.8:1) and text stays navy. The builder must not 'match' the hero by putting green text on paper.

Kakao's pf.kakao.com/_Mxojqs/chat opened with target=_blank inside Instagram's in-app browser may stay in the WebView rather than deep-linking to the Kakao app; keep the href exactly as given, add rel=noopener, and expose the link in three places (timer bar, under the card, bottom bar) so a failed hop is one tap from a retry.

Timer honesty: persisting the start in localStorage means a visitor returning the next day sees the ended state immediately; that is the real condition per brief, and the ended state must keep every CTA and the coupon visible. Also compute remaining time from the stored timestamp, never by decrementing, so backgrounded tabs stay accurate.
Privacy spec text (보유기간, 개인정보처리방침 body) and the '계약 기간' FAQ answer are placeholders the client must confirm before launch; the builder should mark them with a code comment.

Small-phone fold (≈360×560 visible after WebView chrome): the card's lower ~44px falls below the fold; keep the foil prompt in the card's upper 45% and the timer-bar Kakao link always visible so the first frame still has an offer, a promise and a way to act.
Confetti and sparkles are extra canvases/DOM created only on reveal and removed after 1.5s; cap particles at 60 and skip entirely under prefers-reduced-motion to protect low-end devices.

The hero line's angle is set in viewport units at mobile; on desktop widths the same 4.9° rise spans ~100px, so the line must be re-measured on resize to stay centered on the '55,000원' line and run behind (not across) the card column.

typography.rationale: Black Han Sans is literally the wordmark's face (logo-wordmark.svg declares it), so the headline speaks in the logo's voice and the strike-through motif carries across text and logo without a seam. Bebas Neue's tall condensed figures look printed on a receipt and contrast with Black Han Sans's wide blocky Korean so the numbers pop without another weight; its tabular digits keep the timer from jittering. Noto Sans KR is the most legible Korean body face at 14px inside a WebView and ships in unicode-range slices. Montserrat 700 appears only in tiny spaced caps because that is what the badge uses — brand consistency, not decoration. Nothing from the Inter/Space Grotesk family.

concepts.scratch_card: MECHANIC — DOM structure: <div class='stage' style='perspective:900px'> > <button class='coupon' aria-label='쿠폰 긁기: 첫 달 기장료 0원 쿠폰 열기'> (transform-style: preserve-3d; width min(100%, 420px); aspect-ratio 1.6; border-radius 10px — the one deliberately rounded object on the page because it is a physical card) containing (1) .face (the coupon content), (2) .thickness — a ::before copy of the face box at translateZ(-6px) in --navy-900 with a 1px --navy-600 edge, visible only when tilted, which is what sells the object, (3) canvas.foil at translateZ(2px) covering the face (touch-action: none, will-change: transform, 2D context created with willReadFrequently:true, backing store at min(devicePixelRatio, 2)), (4) .glare ::after — a 200%-wide linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.18) 50%, transparent 60%) whose translateX follows tilt so a specular highlight slides across the foil, (5) canvas.confetti overlay (created only at reveal, removed after 900ms). Tilt controller: rotateX = -ty*9°, rotateY = tx*9° where tx/ty ∈ [-1,1] come from (a) pointer position relative to the card center while a pointer is over/on it, (b) deviceorientation gamma/beta (clamped ±30°/±20°, relative to the first reading, low-pass α=0.12) when available, else (c) an idle CSS float: rotateY -4°→4° and translateY 0→-4px over 6s ease-in-out alternate, which stops on first pointerdown. The 3D blade in the Three scene is positioned each frame to project through the card's center (see three_d), so the card visibly rests on the blade. LOOK — face: --navy-700→--navy-800 gradient at 12° with the --stripe texture and a faint 12° green band (rgba(61,220,132,.10), 28px tall) across the middle — the blade 'seen through' the card; 1px inner border rgba(61,220,132,.4). Face content (this part is centered because it is printed on an object): top-left badge SVG 28px; top-right 'COUPON' Montserrat 700 10px .3em --green; middle label '첫 달 기장료' Noto 13px --text-muted; big row '55,000원' Bebas Neue 34px white (원 in Black Han Sans 16px) with an SVG strike line hidden (dashoffset = length) and, to its right, '0원' Black Han Sans 44px --green at opacity 0/scale .7 pre-reveal; bottom-left '쿠폰코드' Noto 11px --text-dim over 'TC-4821' Bebas Neue 26px white .08em; bottom-right '상담 때 말씀해 주세요' 11px --text-dim; along the bottom a dashed 1px perforation and '이 페이지 30분 조건 적용 · 세무회계 민' 9px. Coupon code: 'TC-' + 4 digits generated once, stored in sessionStorage['taxcut_coupon'] (try/catch → in-memory), also written to the hidden form field and the receipt's '쿠폰' row. SILVER LAYER — drawn once on canvas.foil: base linear gradient at 12° (--foil-lo #AEB5C0 → --foil-hi #F2F4F7 at 45% → #C9CED6 → #E6E9EE), a 2px repeating diagonal stripe at rgba(0,0,0,.05) for foil grain, an inner 2px rounded border rgba(11,21,38,.12), then printed in --navy-700: 'TAXCUT' Montserrat 700 10px .3em at top-left; '여기를 긁어보세요' Black Han Sans 24px centered with a 20px coin glyph (navy circle, white ₩, green 12° strike) drawn 8px to its right; '손가락으로 문질러 첫 달 혜택 확인' Noto 12px #3A4A63 centered beneath. Fonts are drawn after document.fonts.ready (redraw once if the foil was painted with fallback). A DOM hand icon (inline SVG, 28px, white 80%) sits over the foil and rubs 24px left-right twice (1.6s) then fades — hidden under prefers-reduced-motion. SCRATCH — pointer events (pointerdown/move/up/cancel, setPointerCapture); on each move draw a round-capped line from the previous point to the current with globalCompositeOperation 'destination-out', lineWidth 44 CSS px; every 8th move sample the alpha channel of getImageData on a 6px grid (~2,000 samples for a 368×230 card) and compute cleared ratio; at ≥45% trigger reveal. Accessibility and lazy paths: Enter/Space on the button triggers reveal directly; after 4s with no scratch a text link appears under the card '긁기 어려우세요? 탭해서 열기' that also reveals. REVEAL MOMENT (≈1.1s total) — t0: foil opacity 1→0 over 350ms and pointer-events none; card does a settle: rotateY(-8°)→0 with scale 1→1.03→1 over 400ms (cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1)); navigator.vibrate?.(12) in try/catch. t0+150ms: the green SVG strike draws across '55,000원' on the face (300ms). t0+450ms: '0원' springs in (opacity 0→1, scale .7→1, 350ms). t0+500ms: coupon code digits type in one by one (4 × 60ms). t0: confetti — 40 rectangles 6×10px in --green / white / --kakao (the yellow foreshadows the Kakao button) burst from the card center on the overlay canvas with gravity and spin, 900ms, then canvas removed. Simultaneously the Three scene fires: blade core opacity .85→1 and glow scaleY 1→2.2 over 250ms then back over 600ms, every shard gets a velocity impulse of 0.9 u/s away from the blade normal (damping .94/frame) plus spin, coins get +2 rad/s tumble — the cut just happened. Reduced-motion: foil fades, strike appears drawn, no confetti (a single 1px green ring expands from the card and fades over 300ms), no settle. WHAT APPEARS AFTER — t0+650ms the CTA block below the card expands (max-height 0→auto via measured height, opacity 0→1, translateY 24→0, 300ms): line 1 '쿠폰코드 TC-4821을 상담 때 말씀해 주세요' Noto 14px 700 white with a '복사' text button (clipboard API in try/catch, toast '쿠폰코드 복사됨'); button 1 Kakao: full width, 56px, --kakao, --kakao-ink Noto 17px 700, inline SVG speech-bubble icon, '카톡으로 바로 상담하기', target _blank rel noopener, tapping also copies the code; button 2 '전화상담 예약하기' outline 1.5px --green, --green text, 52px, smooth-scrolls to #reserve. The pre-scratch escape link stays where it was. Revealed state persists (sessionStorage['taxcut_revealed']=1): on reload the card renders already revealed with no foil, CTAs visible, receipt row '쿠폰 TC-4821 적용' shown, hidden field filled.
concepts.three_d: A) SPLIT — CSS 3D handles everything the user touches or reads (coupon tilt with thickness + glare, the receipt panel's ±3° tilt, the four why-panels receding on a rotateX(4°) stage / fanned rotateY on desktop, tilt-parallax translate of the hero headline). Three.js r128 (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js, defer) handles only the ambient depth field behind the first three sections: receipt shards, coins, and the blade. Nothing interactive lives in WebGL, so if WebGL dies the page loses ambience, not function. B) SCENE — renderer: new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, alpha:true, antialias:false, powerPreference:'high-performance', stencil:false}); setPixelRatio(min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5)); setClearColor(0,0); canvas is position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:1; pointer-events:none, sized from window.innerWidth/innerHeight (resize debounced 150ms and ignored when only the height changed by <120px — the in-app toolbar showing/hiding must not reallocate the drawing buffer mid-scroll). scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0B1526, 6, 20) gives free depth fade. Objects, 5 draw calls total, ~600 triangles: (1) Shards: two InstancedMesh(PlaneGeometry(1,1.4), MeshBasicMaterial({map, transparent, side:DoubleSide, depthWrite:false}), 20) using two 128×192 canvas textures — paper #F3F0E8 fill clipped to a jagged 9-point polygon, 6–7 navy print lines of random length, one dashed rule, a 10px 'TAXCUT' — so they are unmistakably the receipt from section 02. Per instance: position x∈[-6,6], y∈[-5,5], z∈[-8,-1]; scale .5–1.1; fall velocity -0.15…-0.35 u/s; x sway sin(t·ω+φ) amplitude .2; rotation z .1–.3 rad/s and y .2 rad/s for a paper flutter; wrap y<-6 → y=6 at a new random x. Initial spawn clusters within ±.6u of the blade line with an outward normal velocity .3 u/s decaying over 1.5s — the scene opens as 'the blade just cut a receipt'. CPU update: one Object3D dummy, setMatrixAt ×40, instanceMatrix.needsUpdate — ≈0.1ms. (2) Coins: InstancedMesh(CylinderGeometry(.5,.5,.08,20,1), MeshBasicMaterial({map}), 6) with a 64×64 canvas face: --navy-700 disc, 3px --green-deep ring, white ₩ (Black Han Sans if loaded, else 900 sans) with a 12° green strike — the badge's cousin. z∈[-4,-1.5], tumble rotation.x .4 rad/s, rotation.y .25, bob ±.15u. (3) Blade core: Mesh(PlaneGeometry(30,.06), MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x3DDC84, transparent, opacity:.85, blending:AdditiveBlending, depthWrite:false})) rotated z=+0.209 rad (12°) at z=0. (4) Blade glow: PlaneGeometry(30,1.2) with a 4×64 canvas vertical gradient (transparent → #3DDC84 at 35% → transparent), same rotation, additive, at z=-0.01. No lights, no shadows, no post-processing, no antialias, no environment maps. C) CAMERA & PARALLAX — PerspectiveCamera(50, aspect, .1, 40) at (0,0,9), lookAt(0, camY, 0). Scroll: read window.scrollY once per frame (no scroll listener work), camera.position.y = -scrollY·0.0018. Because objects sit at different depths this yields true layered parallax for free: a shard at z=-1 moves ≈15% of scroll speed on screen, at z=-8 ≈9%. The blade is anchored to the coupon: each frame compute the coupon's screen-center y as (cachedRect.top + h/2 − scrollY), convert to NDC, and set blade.position.y = camera.position.y + ndcY · 9 · tan(25°) (blade is at z=0, distance 9) so it scrolls at 1× with the card while shards lag behind it. Rect is cached on resize/orientation change, never read per frame. D) TILT — deviceorientation (passive). Android WebView: attach after the first touchstart anywhere (some WebViews only deliver events after a gesture). iOS ≥13 (Instagram WKWebView): on the first pointerdown on the coupon call DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission() inside try/catch; if it rejects, is absent, or no event arrives within 1.5s, silently use pointer parallax. Map gamma (±30° clamp) → tx∈[-1,1], beta relative to the first reading (±20°) → ty; lerp .08/frame; camera.position.x target = tx·.6, y offset = ty·.4; the same tx/ty are written to CSS vars --tx/--ty on <html> in the same rAF, only when the change exceeds .005, so the DOM layers (headline ±6px, why-panels ±8/6/4/2px, receipt ±3°, coupon ±9°) shift coherently with the WebGL layers. Model for the builder: tilt = depth, scroll = time. E) PERF BUDGET (target Galaxy A3x/A5x class, Adreno 610 / Mali-G52, Chrome WebView inside Instagram) — main-thread JS ≤1.5ms/frame (40 matrix composes + lerps + at most 2 style.setProperty writes), GPU ≤4ms at dpr 1.5 on a 400×800 viewport (600×1200 buffer, one full-screen alpha composite plus one additive glow strip), ≤5 draw calls, ≤700 triangles, 3 tiny textures (128×192 ×2, 64×64) + 1 gradient strip, three.min.js ≈150KB gzipped loaded with defer after all inline page scripts. Hard bans everywhere on the page: backdrop-filter, filter:blur, mix-blend-mode, animated box-shadow, background-attachment:fixed, per-frame getBoundingClientRect, scroll-linked layout writes. Sections carry contain:layout paint. Frame loop runs only while document.visibilityState==='visible' AND an IntersectionObserver on #scene-sentinel (a zero-width absolute div spanning hero→end of the why section) reports intersecting AND reduced-motion is off; otherwise cancelAnimationFrame and the canvas simply holds its last composited frame. pagehide → renderer.dispose() + forceContextLoss(). Delta time capped at 50ms. F) DEGRADE LADDER — initial tier 'low' if navigator.deviceMemory ≤3 OR hardwareConcurrency ≤4 OR (devicePixelRatio ≥3 AND innerWidth <420): dpr 1.0, 20 shards, no coins, glow uses NormalBlending. Runtime monitor: rolling mean of the last 60 frame deltas checked every 2s; if >22ms step down one rung — dpr 1.5→1.0 → drop coins → shards 40→20 → stop the loop and keep the static frame (blade still visible, coupon still tilts because that is CSS). Never re-upgrade (no oscillation). Tier is exposed as <html data-tier> for QA. G) FALLBACK (identical composition, no depth motion) — triggers: !window.WebGLRenderingContext, canvas.getContext('webgl') null, THREE undefined 3s after window load (CDN blocked, e.g. artifact CSP preview), webglcontextlost, prefers-reduced-motion. The fallback is #bg-css, a position:fixed inset:0 z-index:0 layer that is ALWAYS rendered first: 8 inline SVG shards (same jagged polygon + print lines, 36–90px, opacity .3–.6 by depth) with transform-only animation shardDrift (translateY -10%→110% + rotate 0→40°, 18–34s linear infinite, staggered delays, will-change:transform), the blade as a 200vw×3px --green div rotated -12° positioned through the coupon center (top computed once from the coupon rect, follows scroll naturally because it is repositioned via a CSS var updated only on resize — it sits inside the hero, not fixed) with box-shadow 0 0 18px 4px rgba(61,220,132,.45) and a 200vw×48px gradient glow div. Under reduced-motion the animations are none and the shards stand still. When WebGL succeeds the canvas fades in over 500ms while #bg-css fades to 0 then visibility:hidden (no compositing cost); on context loss it is re-shown instantly. H) LOAD ORDER — inline IIFE scripts (timer, coupon, scratch, form) run at parse time; three.min.js is defer; init runs on window load → requestIdleCallback(init, {timeout:1200}) (setTimeout 300 fallback), so LCP (the headline) and the scratch card never wait on WebGL.
concepts.timer_bar: Fixed top, z-index 50, height 48px + env(safe-area-inset-top), --navy-800 at 96% (solid, no blur), 1px bottom hairline rgba(61,220,132,.35). Row (padding 0 16px, align center): 6px --green dot pulsing opacity .5→1 over 2s at left, then label '첫 달 기장료 무료까지' Noto 12px 500 --text-muted (mobile) / '첫 달 기장료 무료까지 남은 시간' (≥600px); right-aligned digits '29:59' Bebas Neue 26px white, letter-spacing .04em, tabular-nums, aria-hidden. Along the bar's bottom edge a 3px track rgba(255,255,255,.08) with a --green fill whose width is driven by transform: scaleX(remaining/1800), transform-origin left, transition transform 1s linear so it glides between ticks on the compositor; the fill's leading edge is a 6px ::after skewed -12° — the blade tip — so the bar visibly 'cuts' the time away from right to left. On ≥900px the bar also hosts two compact CTAs at the right ('카톡 상담' --kakao 36px, '예약하기' outline --green 36px) since the mobile bottom bar is hidden there. Persistence: on first paint read localStorage['taxcut_t0'] (try/catch → sessionStorage → in-memory); if absent set Date.now(); remaining = clamp(1800 − (Date.now()−t0)/1000, 0, 1800); tick with setInterval 1000 re-derived from Date.now() (never decrement) so background tabs stay correct; visibilitychange forces an immediate recompute. Accessibility: a visually-hidden <span aria-live='polite'> updates only on minute change ('남은 시간 29분'), plus once at 5 minutes and at 0. Under 5 minutes (data-urgent): digits and fill switch to --alert #FFB547, dot pulses at 1s, digits scale 1→1.05 for 120ms on each tick, label becomes '5분 남았어요 — 카톡 한 줄이면 돼요'. No red anywhere and no fake countdown restarts. At 0: fill scaleX(0) and stays, digits hidden, dot turns --text-dim, label becomes verbatim '이벤트 시간이 종료되었어요. 그래도 상담은 가능해요' (wraps to 2 lines at 12px if needed; bar grows to 56px), all CTAs unchanged. The hidden form field remaining_seconds and the receipt aside read from the same state object. Reduced-motion: no pulse, no glide (fill snaps).

concepts.motion: PAGE LOAD — 0ms: everything paints static and fully visible: navy + stripes, #bg-css shards in their start positions, the CSS blade, timer bar, lockup, headline, condition line, coupon foil. No text ever waits at opacity 0. 0–400ms: the green strike draws across '55,000원을' in the headline (stroke-dashoffset), then '0원' transitions white→--green over 200ms. This is the only load animation on text and it is additive. ~300–800ms (after window load + idle): Three.js initializes; #bg-gl fades 0→1 over 500ms while #bg-css fades 1→0 (shards are placed at matching screen positions so it reads as a still becoming alive), then #bg-css goes visibility:hidden. 600ms: the 3D blade switches on — glow scaleY .6→1, core opacity 0→.85 over 400ms — and shards, spawned along the blade, drift outward for 1.5s before settling into ambient fall. 800ms: the coupon's idle float begins (6s alternate) and the hand icon rubs twice then fades. Timer fill begins its 1s linear glides. MICRO-INTERACTIONS — coupon tilt from pointer/tilt with a sliding glare; scratch erasing with round-capped strokes and a vibrate(12) on reveal; the reveal sequence (foil fade → card settle → strike → 0원 spring → code type-in → confetti + 3D blade flash + shard impulse → CTA block expands) totalling ≈1.1s; button press: scale .98 + brightness .95 for 120ms; Kakao tap copies the code and shows a 2s toast sliding down from under the timer bar; FAQ marker bar rotates 0→12° on open; form focus ring appears instantly, error text slides down 8px; submit shows a rotating ring, success panel crossfades 300ms; bottom bar slides in when the coupon leaves view; receipt strike draws once on scroll-in, then 0원 pops; under 5 minutes the timer digits pulse each tick. Tilt parallax is a coherent stack: shards ±40px (far) … coupon ±9°, why-panels ±8→2px, headline ±6px, receipt ±3°. Scroll parallax exists only inside WebGL (9–15% of scroll speed by depth) and for the blade tracking the coupon at 1×; no DOM element is scroll-linked, so nothing can jitter on a slow compositor. WHAT STAYS STILL — every paragraph, section header, FAQ, the form, the footer, the timer digits (except <5min), the bottom bar once shown, the receipt panel apart from its one-time strike; no scroll-triggered fade-ins, no counters, no marquee. REDUCED-MOTION — no Three.js (fallback layer, static), no idle float or hand hint, strikes render pre-drawn, timer fill snaps, confetti replaced by one expanding 1px green ring, tilt disabled, bottom bar appears without sliding. PAUSE RULES — the WebGL loop stops when the tab is hidden or the scene sentinel (hero→why) is out of view; CSS animations on hidden layers are visibility:hidden so they cost nothing.

concepts.aesthetic_risk: One diagonal, and it is real. The entire page is rectilinear, left-aligned and still, except a single 12° green blade that exists as an object in the Three.js scene — the coupon physically rests on it, receipt shards fall away from it, the price strikes and the timer's fill tip are drawn parallel to it. This turns the brand's logo gesture (the strike) into the page's spatial spine instead of a decorative underline. It serves conversion because the ad's one promise (55,000원 → 0원) becomes the literal center of gravity: every tilt and scroll re-shows the cut, the scratch reveal is the moment the blade fires, and the CTAs appear as the direct consequence of that cut — the message, the interaction and the ask are the same physical event. The risk is visual noise behind text; it is contained by fog-faded shards capped at 60% opacity, a navy scrim behind the headline column, ≤5 draw calls, and a fallback that is the same composition frozen.
risks: Instagram iOS WKWebView: DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission() may never resolve or may be denied silently; tilt must be purely additive — QA the page with tilt disabled and confirm pointer/scroll parallax alone still reads as depth.

three.min.js from cdnjs can be blocked (artifact CSP preview, corporate/network filters, ad blockers in some in-app browsers): the CSS fallback layer must be pixel-matched to the WebGL first frame; test with the script URL blocked and with WebGL disabled in chrome://flags.

Full-screen alpha WebGL canvas plus four font families on 3GB Android devices can trigger memory pressure and webglcontextlost mid-session; the contextlost handler must re-show #bg-css instantly and never attempt to re-create the renderer more than once.

Black Han Sans arriving late causes a visible font swap on the headline; keep fixed line-heights, set the fallback to 900 weight Malgun/Apple SD, and consider size-adjust on the fallback so wrap points do not change (CLS must stay ~0).

100svh is unsupported in older Android WebViews; ship a JS --vh var and never rely on 100vh for the hero because the in-app toolbar changes innerHeight during scroll — also why canvas resize ignores height-only changes <120px.

getImageData on every pointermove for scratch progress can stall low-end devices; sample every 8th event on a 6px grid with willReadFrequently:true, and confirm the 45% threshold on a real Galaxy A-series in the Instagram browser.

The 30-minute timer is per browser storage: 'Open in Chrome' from the in-app browser restarts it; state this plainly in the footer notice and let the office treat the coupon code as the source of truth rather than the visible clock.

pf.kakao.com/_Mxojqs/chat inside Instagram/당근 WebViews may fail to hand off to the KakaoTalk app; keep the visible fallback hint (브라우저로 열기) and verify the link on both iOS and Android in-app browsers before launch.
Additive-blended green glow over paper-colored shards can bloom to near-white and band on some Mali GPUs; cap glow alpha at 35% and switch to NormalBlending on the low tier.
The amber urgency color under 5 minutes is a fourth hue; keep it strictly to the timer digits/fill so it reads as caution rather than error, and never introduce red outside form validation on paper.
Claims '세무사가 직접' and '온라인 계약' must be confirmed true with 세무회계 민 before launch; no numeric claims are used anywhere, keep it that way in future edits.
Pre-scratch drop-off: users who read the foil as a static image may bounce; the escape link above the card and the 4-second '탭해서 열기' hint are load-bearing, do not remove them for visual tidiness.

scores.notes: The foil ticket is the best single hook object of the three (a thumb has something to do in second one), but the first frame around it is the busiest: 56px HUD with eyebrow + label + 30px digits + status chip + Kakao square + 30-segment health bar, then a 24px ticker, then wordmark row, then H1. That is ~136px of chrome before the offer on a 650px viewport. The H1 '기장료 55,000원, 긁어서 0원으로.' omits '첫 달' (the ad says 첫 달; a headline implying 기장료 is 0 outright is a clarity and honesty miss) and makes scratching the cause of 0원, which is not the condition. Arcade vocabulary (PRESS START, STAGE, HUD, 'COUPON GET', attract ticker, 'CLEAR' stamp) reads like a crypto/game promo, not a 세무사 사무소; the concept itself admits the ticker reads cheap and the palette can tip into carnival. CTA coverage is the strongest of the three: Kakao square in the sticky bar from first paint, anti-bounce link under the ticket, sticky bottom bar, post-reveal row, HUD coupon chip. Feasibility: Three.js r128 (~600KB), foil canvas, confetti canvas, 30 per-second segment transitions, ticker, coin spray and tilt all in an Instagram WebView; the deferral/fallback plan is competent but it is a lot of surface to keep at 60fps on a Galaxy A. '서두르세요, 5분 남았어요' is pressure copy; '긁기 귀찮으면' is a bit flippant.

scores.notes: Cleanest first frame: 48px bar, logo row, then '첫 달 기장료, / 55,000원 (struck edge-to-edge) / 0원으로 잘라드려요.' The offer is understood before reading, it matches the ad word for word, and the giant numerals carry the brand verb (자르다). Card fully in frame at 400x660. Offer clarity is the best: verbatim 30분 sentence in the subhead, a 3-row price table (첫 달 0원 / 둘째 달부터 55,000원 / 매출액 구간 상담 시 안내), footer 유의사항 that even discloses the timer is per-device. Trust is the highest: no gamer vocabulary, amber (not red) urgency, no invented claims, calm paper sections, FAQ in '상담 시 안내' tone. CTA is the soft spot pre-scratch: the bar's '카톡 상담 →' and the under-card link are 13px text links; only the bottom bar is a real button before reveal, and the post-reveal Kakao button lands below the fold on a 660px viewport. Feasibility is the best by far: CSS 3D only, JS <12KB, DPR<=1.5, no iOS permission prompt, canvas sampling on pointerup. Distinctiveness is real but quieter; the risk that it looks 'unfinished' is acceptable because restraint is what loads and scrolls well in-app. Copy issues: '전화 예약하기 (30초)' overpromises for a 7-field form; '시작됩니다' breaks the 해요체 register; '0원' at 84px glued to '으로 잘라드려요.' at 30px will wrap on 360px phones.

Strongest message architecture in the hero: '사장님,' direct address, 3-line headline, then the verbatim 30분 condition as a highlighted line under the headline. That condition-line placement is the single best offer-clarity move of all three concepts. But the hero stacks eyebrow + headline + condition + subhead + escape link before the card, so the foil prompt sits at y~537 on a 640 viewport and the card bottom is cut; on Instagram's real ~600px usable height the card is barely a hook. Drifting receipt shards, coins and a glowing blade behind the headline column is visual noise exactly where the eye should rest, and it tilts the mood toward 'game/crypto' for a tax office. CTA is the weakest pre-scratch: no Kakao button in the mobile bar, the bottom bar appears only after the coupon scrolls out, so a non-scratcher's only CTA is a 13px right-aligned link. Feasibility is the concern that decides it: a full-screen fixed alpha WebGL canvas under scrolling DOM, per-frame blade anchoring, degrade ladder, tier monitor, 3D why-panels with font compensation, plus DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission() fired on the first pointerdown on the coupon, which pops an iOS permission dialog in the middle of the first scratch stroke. '지어낸 숫자 대신, 실제로 하는 것만 적었어요' is an odd thing to say out loud; '담당자가 바뀌어 처음부터 다시 설명할 일이 없어요' is an unverified claim.
