must_fix: Headline line 3 will wrap and look broken: '0원' at 84px Montserrat plus '원' in Black Han Sans plus '으로 잘라드려요.' at 30px on one baseline is ~380px wide, wider than a 360px phone's content column. Force the break as '0원으로' (0원 at 64-72px, 으로 at 30px baseline-aligned) / '잘라드릴게요.' on its own line, and test at 360px with the fallback font.
Remove '(30초)' from '전화 예약하기 (30초)'. The form has 7 fields plus consent; promising 30 seconds is a small lie on a page whose whole pitch is honesty. Use '전화 상담 예약하기'.

Post-reveal Kakao button lands below the fold: the card ends at ~604px on a 660px viewport, so the 56px Kakao button that rises under it sits at ~620-676px, under the bottom bar. On reveal, smooth-scroll the CTA slot into view (scrollIntoView block 'nearest' after the 300ms expand), or render the Kakao button on the coupon face itself so the reward and the ask are one object.

Scratch progress is sampled only on pointerup, so a visitor doing one long continuous rub gets no reveal until they lift their finger. Add a throttled sample during pointermove (every ~150ms on the 1/4-scale copy) so the card opens mid-stroke at 45%.

Pointer-to-canvas mapping under a 3D transform: 'freezing' the tilt at rotateY 3° still leaves the canvas skewed, so erased strokes drift from the fingertip. On pointerdown set the card transform to identity with no transition, then read getBoundingClientRect; restore tilt on pointerup.

Timer bar Kakao link must be a real yellow button (see graft), and the under-card escape link should be a 44px-tall tappable row, not 13px text. Pre-scratch, a 13px link is the only Kakao exit above the bottom bar.

Register consistency: the page is 해요체 but drops into 합니다체 in '카톡 한 번이면 시작됩니다', '30분이면 됩니다', '장부는 저희가 만듭니다', '세무사가 직접 봅니다'. Pick 해요체 throughout ('시작돼요', '30분이면 돼요', '만들어요', '봐요'); the mix reads as two writers.
Replace '서류 없이 온라인으로 계약해요' with '방문 없이 온라인으로 계약해요'. 'No documents' is a claim the office almost certainly cannot honour; 'no visit' is what the brief actually says.

Expired-timer coupon logic: after 0:00 the card must not issue a new code, and an already-revealed coupon should carry a small '시간 종료' mark while every CTA stays live. Right now CUT LINE keeps the coupon fully valid-looking forever.

Font stack-order trick (Montserrat first, Black Han Sans second) needs font-synthesis: none AND a size-adjust on the Hangul fallback; otherwise digits and Hangul swap in at different times and the struck '55,000원' line moves under the already-drawn hero line. Re-measure the line's y on fonts.ready as well as on resize.
The why-section heading '세무 몰라도 괜찮아요, 사장님.' repeats the hero subhead almost verbatim two screens later; change one (suggest hero keeps it, why-section becomes '처음이라 모르는 게 당연해요').

Footer trust block for a tax office is thin: add placeholders for 세무사 성명, 사무소 주소, 사업자등록번호 and 대표 전화 to be filled by 세무회계 민 (do not invent), and mark the 보유기간 wording and the 계약 기간 FAQ answer with code comments as client-to-confirm, as the concept already intends.
judgments.copy_verdict: Headline: CUT LINE's structure is the strongest of the three because it matches the ad ('첫 달 기장료 0원') word for word, keeps the brand verb, and lets the numerals do the talking; Scratch & Cut's '기장료 55,000원, 긁어서 0원으로.' fails on omission (no '첫 달') and on cause (scratching does not make it 0원); CUT PLANE's is honest and warm but too long for 38px over a noisy background. Ship this: line 1 '사장님, 첫 달 기장료' (Black Han Sans 32px) / line 2 '55,000원' (Montserrat 900 54px, struck by the edge-to-edge line) / line 3 '0원으로' (0원 64-72px green, 으로 30px) / line 4 '잘라드릴게요.' (30px). '잘라드릴게요' beats '잘라드려요' for this audience: it is a promise addressed to a person, not a product statement. Condition line directly beneath, verbatim: '이 페이지에서 30분 안에 상담 및 계약 완료 시 첫 달 기장료 무료'. Subhead: '세무를 몰라도 괜찮아요. 카톡 한 줄로 세무사와 상담하고, 계약은 온라인으로 끝나요.' (drop '시작됩니다'). Kakao CTA: use '카톡으로 바로 상담하기' on the big buttons (Scratch & Cut / CUT PLANE wording; '바로' is the friction-killer) with a 12px caption '질문 한 줄부터 괜찮아요' to lower the bar for people who dread calls, and '카톡 상담' in the bars; '카톡으로 상담 시작' is fine but '시작' sounds like a commitment. Reserve CTA: '전화 상담 예약하기' (spaced, no '(30초)'); submit button '예약 신청하기' is fine. Scratch prompt: '여기를 긁어보세요' (the -보세요 invitation beats Scratch & Cut's imperative '긁으세요') with Scratch & Cut's sub-line '쓱쓱 긁으면 첫 달 기장료가 잘려요', which is the most natural and the most fun of the three. Escape link: '긁지 않아도 돼요 · 바로 카톡 상담 →'. Reveal: '첫 달 기장료 0원 쿠폰' / 'TC-4821' / '상담 때 이 코드를 말씀해 주세요'. Timer: '첫 달 기장료 무료까지 남은 시간' (all three agree); under 5 minutes '5분 남았어요 — 카톡 한 줄이면 돼요'; never '서두르세요'. Section titles worth keeping from CUT LINE: '카톡이 제일 빨라요', '30분이면 돼요.'; from Scratch & Cut: '요금, 솔직하게.'. Avoid any Konglish gamer labels (PRESS START, COUPON GET, STAGE) on a tax office page.

scores.notes: Best scratch spec of the three: touch-action:none plus a non-passive touchmove preventDefault on the foil, setPointerCapture, 3-sample tap guard, progress every 120ms from a 1/4-scale offscreen copy, pre-revealed session state, and an honest expired-timer reveal. The Three plan is also sane (inject after load via rIC, hero-only canvas, 2 InstancedMesh + 2 lights, DPR 1.5, IO + visibility pause, 30fps cap, CSS coin fallback, skipped on saveData/low memory/reduced-motion). What blows the budget on a Galaxy A-class WebView is everything stacked around it: a 60s marquee, colon blink, dot pulse, sheen tracking, and a 30-segment health bar that animates `width` (layout every frame for 0.9s of every second, for the life of the page); DOM foil-shaving divs spawned every 80ms during the exact frames the stroke must stay smooth; and a reveal that fires a clip-path wipe, card pop, flash overlay, SVG strike, 90-particle full-screen confetti, Three coin spray and a max-height layout animation at the same time. Foil at DPR 2 means ~1.35MB of canvas texture re-uploaded per scratched frame on DPR 3 phones (cap at 1.5). The iOS DeviceOrientation permission request 'on the first touch' will pop an OS dialog in the middle of the first scratch and cancel the pointer. ~60KB inline JS, four font families, Noto Sans KR at 3 weights (each weight multiplies the sliced-Korean download). Every item is fixable, but the concept as written ships over budget and needs a diet before it hits 60fps inside Instagram.

scores.concept: CUT LINE — 한 줄로 자르는 에디토리얼
scores.notes: The only concept whose steady state is compositor-only: timer line is transform:scaleX with a 1s linear transition, idle float and tilt are one transform on one preserve-3d group, no WebGL, no marquee, one confetti canvas that lives 1.5s. Foil canvas at DPR <=1.5, touch-action:none plus overscroll-behavior:none, pointer capture, rAF-batched strokes, tilt frozen on pointerdown, and no iOS permission prompt (touch-position tilt instead) are all the right calls for Instagram/당근 WebViews. First paint is fonts plus a few KB of JS. Deductions: alpha sampling only on pointerup means the reveal never fires mid-stroke (feels dead while rubbing); the 64px fixed bottom bar is present from load and sits over the card's lower edge in the stated first frame (card 388-604 on a ~660px viewport, worse at 560); the Montserrat-first stack trick depends on font-synthesis:none (Chrome/WebView 97+) and will fake-bold Black Han Sans on older WebViews; a tilt frozen at +-8/10deg still leaves the canvas off-axis during a stroke, so getBoundingClientRect mapping drifts toward the card edges; the edge-to-edge hero line must be re-measured after document.fonts.ready or it misses the '55,000원' line once the Korean slices swap in; '<12KB JS' is not realistic once the form adapter, validation, auto-hyphen, tilt, scratch, confetti and IntersectionObservers are in (budget 20-25KB minified). Hook is the weakest of the three because nothing demonstrates the gesture; that is a cheap graft from A.

The most ambitious and the least shippable inside an in-app WebView. A full-viewport position:fixed alpha WebGL canvas is re-rendered every frame during scroll (camera follows scrollY) beneath transparent faux-glass DOM, so every scroll frame is a WebGL render plus a full-screen blend on top of the normal DOM raster; on Mali-G52 MC2 devices (Galaxy A2x/A3x) this dips below 60 exactly while the user is scrolling to the CTA. three.min.js as `defer` parses and compiles ~600KB on the main thread before DOMContentLoaded (A's post-load rIC injection is the correct pattern). Tilt is never frozen during scratching: pointer-driven +-9deg tilt moves the canvas under the finger, so destination-out strokes land off the fingertip; deviceorientation makes it worse. iOS DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission on the first coupon pointerdown pops an OS dialog mid-stroke (pointercancel, trust hit). Body text inside preserve-3d layers (why-panels at translateZ -10..-30 with a 4deg stage, receipt at +-3deg, headline parallax) re-rasters or blurs on Android. The cached coupon rect that positions the blade goes stale after the Black Han Sans swap reflow and after the post-reveal CTA block expands. 'Pixel-matched' SVG-to-WebGL handoff plus a runtime degrade ladder is weeks of device QA for a background nobody taps. The hero also stacks eyebrow + 3-line 38px headline + condition block + 2-line subhead + link before the card, and '0원으로 잘라 드릴게요' wraps at 360px, pushing the foil prompt to the fold edge. Keep its good ideas: willReadFrequently:true, bottom bar deferred until the coupon leaves the viewport, blade-tip timer fill, card thickness layer, the '브라우저로 열기' hint, the 4s '탭해서 열기' link, and ignoring <120px height-only resizes.

judgments.winner: CUT LINE — 한 줄로 자르는 에디토리얼
graft_from_others: From A: the gesture demo. One DOM coin (or hand) element drags a translate() path lower-left to upper-right across the foil at t+900ms, repeats once at 2.5s and once more after 12s idle, then parks bottom-right. Transform-only, no canvas repaint. B currently has no hint at all, which is why its 3s hook is the weakest.

From A: mid-stroke progress. Sample cleared ratio every ~120ms during pointermove (1/4-scale offscreen drawImage + getImageData, or full getImageData on a willReadFrequently canvas) and fire the reveal at 45% while the finger is still down; keep B's pointerup sample as the final check.

From A: a 36-40px --kakao square with the inline bubble SVG in the timer bar (aria-label '카카오톡 상담') instead of B's 13px text link, and A's coupon chip in the bar after reveal (tap copies, flips to '복사됨' 1.5s) so the code is on screen wherever the visitor scrolls. Yellow stays Kakao-only, so it does not break B's palette rules.

From A: expired-timer honesty. The foil still scratches after 0:00, but the coupon face shows '이벤트 종료 · 상담은 계속 가능해요' and no code is issued or stored; plus A's pre-revealed render when a stored coupon exists so a refresh never asks anyone to scratch twice.

From C: the bottom CTA bar is not rendered until the coupon leaves the viewport (IntersectionObserver), slides away on focusin and visualViewport resize (Android keyboard) and on the success screen. This fixes B's first-frame overlap between the fixed bar and the card.

From C: willReadFrequently:true on the foil 2D context (CPU-backed from the start, predictable readbacks), and the visible '긁기 어려우세요? 탭해서 열기' link after 4s with no scratch; B's visually-hidden-until-focused button only helps keyboard users.
From C: Kakao fallback fine print under every Kakao button: '카톡이 열리지 않으면 우측 상단 ⋯ 메뉴에서 「브라우저로 열기」를 눌러 주세요', and C's under-5-minute label '5분 남았어요 — 카톡 한 줄이면 돼요'.

From C: the card thickness pseudo-layer (translateZ(-6px) navy plate with a 1px edge) that sells the tilt as an object, and the skewX(-12deg) blade tip on the timer's progress line. Both are zero per-frame cost and tie B's single-line motif to the logo.

From C: put the verbatim 30-minute sentence in its own block with a 2px green left rule between headline and subhead, instead of burying it inside the paragraph; C's subhead wording ('카톡 한 줄로 세무사와 상담하고, 계약은 온라인으로 끝나요') is also the clearest for someone who does not know what 기장 is.

From A: the rule that everything triggered by the reveal animates below the finger (CTA slot grows downward, nothing above the card shifts) and that the confetti canvas is pointer-events:none and gone within 1.5s so it can never eat the first Kakao tap.
must_fix: First-frame collision: the 64px fixed bottom bar covers the card's lower edge (card 388-604 on ~660px, far worse on 360x560). Defer the bar until the coupon leaves the viewport (C's rule), hide it on focusin/visualViewport resize and on the success panel, and re-check the 400x640 and 360x560 frames with the bar absent.

Scratch mapping: on pointerdown snap tilt to 0 (<=80ms, no lerp), stop the idle float and deviceorientation updates for the stroke, read getBoundingClientRect once after the snap and scale by canvas.width/rect.width; never read the rect per pointermove. A frozen non-zero tilt leaves the canvas off-axis and strokes drift at the edges.

Foil canvas: DPR cap 1.5, willReadFrequently:true, progress sampled every ~120ms mid-stroke plus on pointerup, threshold 45%. Move the foil prompt text ('여기를 긁어보세요' + caption) to a DOM layer above the canvas with pointer-events:none that fades to 0 once ~10% is cleared, so text stays crisp on DPR 3 phones and the canvas never needs a repaint after document.fonts.ready.

Fonts: two weights per family max (drop Noto Sans KR 500 and Montserrat 800; digits/codes use 900). One Google Fonts link with display=swap and preconnect to fonts.gstatic.com. Add a local() fallback @font-face for Black Han Sans with size-adjust/ascent-override against the system Korean sans at 700 and fixed line-heights so wrap points hold through the sliced-font swap. Recompute the hero line's y after document.fonts.ready and on resize/orientationchange.

Drop the Montserrat-first stack + font-synthesis:none trick. Wrap digits, prices and codes in a .num span set explicitly in Montserrat 900 and keep headline elements at font-weight 400 in Black Han Sans; older Android WebViews without font-synthesis support will otherwise fake-bold the Hangul. Also clamp() the 34/54/84px headline sizes: at 360px width '0원'(84px) + '으로 잘라드려요.'(30px) exceeds 328px and wraps to a third line, pushing the card off the fold.

Kakao link inside Instagram/당근 WebViews: target=_blank is unreliable there (opened in place or swallowed by the host). When the UA matches /Instagram|FBAN|FBAV|TowneersApp|Daangn/i (verify 당근's UA string on a device) render a plain href with no target; keep target=_blank rel=noopener elsewhere; keep C's '브라우저로 열기' hint under every Kakao button.

html, body { overflow-x: clip } (not hidden, which breaks sticky/fixed positioning and scroll anchoring) plus overscroll-behavior-y: none; the -5vw..105vw hero line must live inside an overflow-clipped hero wrapper or it creates horizontal scroll on desktop with scrollbars.

Timer: derive remaining from the stored timestamp every tick (already specified), force a recompute on visibilitychange and pageshow, and when remaining hits 0 while a stroke is in progress the reveal must take the expired path. When the stored start is older than EVENT_MINUTES on load, do not treat a stored coupon/revealed flag as a valid discount (show the ended state on the coupon face).

Pull-to-refresh: some in-app hosts wrap the WebView in a native swipe-refresh that CSS cannot disable. Rely on touch-action:none plus a non-passive touchmove preventDefault on the foil (the WebView then reports the touch as consumed) and make the hint stroke diagonal so the natural first gesture is not a vertical pull from scrollTop 0. Test on Instagram Android at scrollTop 0.

Set the JS budget at 20-25KB minified (not 12KB) so the builder does not strip the form adapter, validation, auto-hyphen or observers to hit a number; wrap every localStorage/sessionStorage/clipboard/vibrate call in one guarded helper (artifact preview runs in a sandboxed iframe where storage can throw and vibrate/orientation are blocked).
judgments.copy_verdict: Strongest headline structure is B's: '첫 달 기장료, / 55,000원 / 0원으로 잘라드려요.' The price and the cut are read pre-attentively and '잘라드려요' is the brand verb. A's '긁어서 0원으로' misattributes the discount to scratching (the real condition is 30분 안에 상담·계약, and the office will have to un-teach that), and C's one 3-line sentence at 38px is the slowest read and wraps at 360px. Strongest subhead is C's ('카톡 한 줄로 세무사와 상담하고, 계약은 온라인으로 끝나요. 아래 카드를 긁으면 첫 달 0원 쿠폰이 나와요.') because it tells a 26-year-old who has never heard the word 기장 what happens next in plain words. Strongest Kakao CTA is A/C's '카톡으로 바로 상담하기' ('바로' lowers the perceived commitment); B's '카톡으로 상담 시작' is flatter. Drop B's '(30초)' from the reserve CTA: the form has eight fields, it is an overclaim. Recommended set for the winner: eyebrow '첫 창업 사장님을 위한 세무 기장 서비스' (glosses 기장 as 세무); headline '첫 달 기장료,' / '55,000원' (struck by the line) / '0원으로 잘라드려요.'; condition block on its own line with a green left rule: '이 페이지에서 30분 안에 상담 및 계약 완료 시 첫 달 기장료 무료'; subhead: '카톡 한 줄로 세무사와 상담하고, 계약은 온라인으로 끝나요. 세무를 몰라도 괜찮아요, 사장님.'; foil prompt: '여기를 손가락으로 긁으세요' with caption '긁으면 첫 달 0원 쿠폰이 나와요'; pre-scratch escape link: '긁지 않아도 돼요 · 바로 카톡 상담 →'; reveal: '첫 달 기장료 0원 쿠폰' / '코드 TC-4821' / '상담 때 이 코드를 말씀해 주세요'; CTA 1 '카톡으로 바로 상담하기', CTA 2 '전화 상담 예약하기'; bottom bar '카톡 상담' / '예약하기'; timer label '첫 달 기장료 무료까지' on mobile ('…남은 시간' added at >=600px); under 5 minutes '5분 남았어요 — 카톡 한 줄이면 돼요'; expired: the verbatim '이벤트 시간이 종료되었어요. 그래도 상담은 가능해요'.

scores.notes: The ticket-as-hero is the best single bet for a touch-first audience, and the silver foil object is the most arresting first frame of the three. But the arcade is a second metaphor stacked on top of the brand's one motif: PRESS START / STAGE / HELP / COUPON GET stamps / a 30-segment health bar / an attract ticker / coins. The page becomes a game cabinet that happens to contain a cut line rather than being the cut line. Four typefaces, three accent hues, chamfers on everything, sawtooth edges, stamps, foil shavings, confetti and a Three.js coin field: the concept has to invent 'role rules' to stop itself tipping into carnival, which is the tell that the system is over-full. Motion is scattered, not orchestrated: a 10-step reveal plus continuous colon blink, dot pulse, ticker, drifting coins and shavings. The headline drops '첫 달' and literally claims '긁어서 0원으로', which the brief's no-과장 rule forbids. In-app smells: per-second width transitions on 30 segments in a sticky bar, a 'fixed' stripe texture, a 600KB Three payload, and an iOS deviceorientation permission dialog popping on the first touch mid-scratch. Trust for a tax office is the weak leg: a 28-year-old will smile, then wonder whether to hand a slot machine their books.

scores.concept: CUT LINE — 한 줄로 자르는 에디토리얼
scores.notes: The only concept whose entire ornament vocabulary is the brand mark. The green line is the hero gesture, the timer progress, the CTA underline, the FAQ indicator (a cut mark that rotates, not a chevron), the process rail and the section rule; the giant green 0원 at 84px is the pre-attentive read before any copy. Typography is a genuine point of view: the wordmark faces enlarged, with a real mechanism (Montserrat-first stack + font-synthesis: none) so every digit falls into Montserrat 900 automatically. One orchestrated moment on load (line draws edge to edge, 55,000원 dims, 0원 pops) and one on reveal; everything else is still. CSS-only 3D with a 12KB JS budget, no permission prompts, DPR capped at 1.5 and compositor-only animation is the correct reading of an Instagram/당근 WebView on a Galaxy A. The bets to fix: '왜 택스컷' and '진행 절차' are so restrained they risk reading as unstyled on a phone; the timer bar's exit is a 13px text link; two cut angles (5° wide, 12° tight) contradict 'one line'; scratch progress samples only on pointerup so the reveal cannot fire mid-stroke; the reveal's corner-to-corner line crosses the 0원 the concept swears is never struck; the timer's ended state still issues a coupon; and nothing animates on the foil to tell a scan-reader it is scratchable.

The blade-as-spatial-spine is the most ambitious single idea in the set, and the details prove real system thinking: the timer fill's skewed blade tip, the FAQ bar rotating to 12°, shards textured as the receipt from section 02, the hero condition line set as a designed rule, '지어낸 숫자 대신, 실제로 하는 것만 적었어요'. But the surface it is dressed in — faux-glass panels, floating particles, fog, additive glow strips, fanned rotateY cards on a rotateX stage — is the stock AI-landing kit the judge is asked to penalize, and the ₩ coins are a second object with no reason to exist. The hero front-loads five text blocks (eyebrow, 3-line H1 at only 38px, condition rule, 2-line subhead, link) before the card, so 0원 is never the first thing the eye lands on and the toy sits at y=422. Pre-scratch the only CTA on screen is a right-aligned 13px link; the bottom bar is deferred. A full-viewport fixed WebGL layer with a scroll-linked camera, four DOM tilt layers applied to text (rotateX on a paragraph stack rasterizes blurry in WebView), four font families, an iOS permission call on the coupon's first pointerdown, and a pixel-matched CSS fallback that must be built twice: this is the heaviest build and the one most likely to ship compromised inside Instagram.

must_fix: One angle, one token. The concept specifies the wide hero line at about 5° (wordmark ratio) and the tight rules, FAQ marker and coupon underline at -12° (badge ratio). Two angles kill the thesis that there is one line. Define a single --cut-angle from the wordmark (the mark that actually sits on the page at 110px) and use it for the hero line, timer tip, section rules, FAQ marker, process rail and coupon underline. If the shallow angle makes the short rules read as underlines, lengthen them rather than steepening them.

The reveal must not strike the 0원. The spec draws a 4px green line corner to corner across the whole coupon face, which crosses the '0원' the concept explicitly says is never struck. Route the reveal cut across the foil layer only (it fades with the foil) or through the perforation strip beneath the code, and keep the 0원 underline as the only green mark on the opened face.

Headline wrap at 360px. Line 3 sets '0원' at 84px and '으로 잘라드려요.' at 30px on one baseline; at 328px of content width this is within a few pixels of wrapping mid-phrase. Specify the behavior: below 380px the tail drops to its own line under the 0원, or 0원 steps down to 72px. Never let the browser decide where that line breaks.

Scratch reveal timing. Sampling cleared pixels only on pointerup means a continuous scratch past 45% shows nothing until the finger lifts, a dead half-second at the exact moment the page should pay off. Sample during the stroke on a throttled 1/4-scale copy (see graft) and fire the reveal mid-stroke.

Snap the tilt to zero on pointerdown rather than freezing at the current angle. Mapping pointer coordinates onto a canvas that is still rotated 3° through a perspective wrapper introduces a small but visible offset between thumb and cleared foil; a 120ms transition to rotate(0) before the first draw makes the brush exact. Also stop the idle float on first pointerdown, not only during scratching.

Expired-timer state on the coupon. Persisting the start time in localStorage means returning visitors land in the ended state; the card must then reveal '이벤트 종료 · 상담은 계속 가능해요' with no code issued, the pill beside the form heading must not appear, and the hidden coupon_code field must submit empty. Right now the card generates and stores a code regardless.

First-frame overlap. The fixed 64px bottom bar covers the card's lower edge on a 400x660 first paint (card ends at 604, bar begins at 596). Either defer the bar until the card leaves the viewport (graft from CUT PLANE) or add 72px of hero bottom padding so the card clears it.

The timer bar's exit is a text link. Pre-scratch, the most visible CTA on the first screen is a 13px underlined '카톡 상담 →'. Make it the 36px yellow Kakao mini-button. Keep the underline sweep for the link under the card.

'왜 택스컷' and '진행 절차' need one more level of hierarchy on a phone. Four titles with a 28px rule and a paragraph will read as unstyled text on navy to a 25-year-old scrolling in Instagram. Keep no cards, but give each point a 28px 2px-stroke green line icon drawn from the badge vocabulary (bubble, person-with-badge, sprout, play) or a Montserrat 900 numeral at 36px green at 40% opacity behind the title, so the two sections share the process section's numeral system.

No off-token colors. The confetti spec introduces #9BF0C3; the alert amber (#FFB020) is a fourth hue. Make confetti --green / --green-deep / --paper / --ink only, and keep amber strictly to the timer line and digits under 5:00. Add every color to :root before build, including the foil stops.

Foil paint order. Paint the foil canvas after document.fonts.ready with a one-time repaint fallback; otherwise the '여기를 긁어보세요' prompt is rasterized in Malgun Gothic for the whole session on any device where Black Han Sans arrives late, which in a WebView is most of them.
Duplicate copy. The subhead says '세무를 몰라도 괜찮아요, 사장님.' and the '왜 택스컷' heading says '세무 몰라도 괜찮아요, 사장님.' Change the section heading (suggested below).
Drop '(30초)' from the reserve CTA. A seven-field form with two selects, a date and a consent box is not 30 seconds; the brief bans 과장 and a founder who takes 90 seconds notices.
judgments.copy_verdict: Strongest headline: CUT LINE's '첫 달 기장료, / 55,000원 / 0원으로 잘라드려요.' It keeps '첫 달' (honest scope), uses the brand's own verb 자르다 in the office's voice (we cut it for you), and is structured for the visual so the line has something to strike. Scratch & Cut's '기장료 55,000원, 긁어서 0원으로.' is the punchiest but fails the brief twice: it drops '첫 달' and it claims that scratching is what makes it 0원, when the real condition is 30분 안에 상담·계약. CUT PLANE's '사장님, 첫 달 기장료 55,000원을 0원으로 잘라 드릴게요' is honest and warm but too long for a 38px three-line hero, and '잘라 드릴게요' is inconsistently spaced (should be 잘라드릴게요). Keep CUT LINE's headline as written. Subhead: use CUT LINE's structure but fold in CUT PLANE's pointer to the card, and move the verbatim condition sentence out into its own ruled line above it: condition line '이 페이지에서 30분 안에 상담 및 계약 완료 시 첫 달 기장료 무료', then subhead '세무를 몰라도 괜찮아요, 사장님. 아래 카드를 긁으면 첫 달 0원 쿠폰이 나오고, 카톡 한 번이면 시작돼요.' Bottom bar per brief: '카톡 상담' / '예약하기'. Pre-scratch escape link under the card: '긁지 않아도 돼요 · 바로 카톡 상담 →' (CUT PLANE's phrasing is the least apologetic). Timer label stays as the brief's '첫 달 기장료 무료까지 남은 시간'; under 5 minutes use CUT PLANE's '5분 남았어요 — 카톡 한 줄이면 돼요' rather than Scratch & Cut's '서두르세요', which is the manufactured urgency the brief bans; at zero, the brief's sentence verbatim.
